column4: cleat#1963: defense-in-depth check that sp_reset_connection (go-mssqldb's answer to database/sql's ResetSession) actually resets SET LOCK_TIMEOUT to -1 on a recycled pooled connection, SQL Server only -- this job sets CLEAT_TEST_DB (postgres) but no CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, so the test skips here on every run. Measured: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL go test ./engine/ -run TestMSSQLLockTimeoutDoesNotSurviveAPooledConnectionRecycle -count=1 -json | grep '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly one.
